en: A black and white vintage postcard depicting a grand Gothic-style building complex with ornate stonework, pointed arches, and towers. The scene is framed by a wrought iron fence, and a man stands on the sidewalk in front. The left side shows a smaller, simpler building covered in vegetation, while the right side features an elaborate structure with arched windows and intricate details. The text at the top identifies the location as 'Le Musée de Dentelles (Gruuthuse)' in Bruges.
